description: This line plot is named SepLLM. The x-axis plots Training Time (s) on a linear scale from 0.00 to 25000 while the y-axis plots Loss on a linear scale from 2.45 to 2.75. The line plot has two lines, one in red and one in blue. The red line represents the vanilla Transformer and the blue line represents the SepLLM. The red line starts at a loss of 2.75 and ends at a loss of 2.45. The blue line starts at a loss of 2.75 and ends at a loss of 2.45. The blue line is consistently below the red line throughout the plot.
